title: Vesper and the Spire Anew
author: Ada Nakamura
blurb: Petra Marchetti, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
